caption: Svaneke Harbour, Svaneke
composition: Granite harbour, boats and a smokehouse skyline · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the quay, Svaneke harbour is a small granite basin of moored boats, with painted houses close to the water and a smokehouse of tall chimneys. The chimneys are not smoking. The night is overcast, about 14.7°C, and the quay is empty. There is no lighthouse beam. The old stone lighthouse southeast of the harbour was taken out of use in 2010.
